# usage appellation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](gmeow-usageAppellation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageAppellation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The appellation used to call the named entity in a name-usage.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](gmeow-usageAppellation.md) from [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) to [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md), [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the appellation player of a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) — which [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) is used to call the named entity in this use.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as a direct bearing property (that is [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md)) and avoid attaching it to anything but a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md); it names a relator player, not a borne name.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](gmeow-usageAppellation.md) to the [`Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) once per [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) (functional), pairing it with [`gmeow:usageNamed`](gmeow-usageNamed.md); the name's language and purpose are read from the bound [`Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md).

### Examples

- ex:usageFamily [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](gmeow-usageAppellation.md) ex:gennyAunt.
